# Northfield Trail Supply Fall Membership Campaign
Campaign brief | Prepared 08/24/2026

## Objective and offer
Increase new Northfield Trail Supply memberships by 18% over the prior fall campaign while keeping paid acquisition cost below $32 per member. The campaign promotes the Northfield Monthly Trail Box, a subscription with seasonal trail essentials and gear-care items.

| Offer detail | Approved value |
| --- | --- |
| Trial period | 30 days |
| Recurring charge after trial | $19 per month |
| Cancellation | Online through the member account before the next billing date |
| Campaign dates | 09/14/2026–10/11/2026 |

## Audience and creative
Target adults ages 25–54 in Colorado, Utah, and Wyoming who have visited Northfield product pages or opted in to marketing email. Exclude current members and anyone who unsubscribed. Hector Kim owns the creative brief; Omar Haddad coordinates paid media; Walter Ferreira approves final copy and spend.

Creative direction: show practical use of the box on a day hike, with the headline "Ready for the next trail." Do not imply that every box contains the same items; contents vary by season. The landing page must present the offer and collect consent before enrollment.

## Channel plan and schedule
Paid social flight: 09/14/2026–10/11/2026. Email sends are scheduled for 09/14 and 09/28; suppress members and unsubscribed contacts before each send. The landing page and tracking events are due for QA by 09/08. Omar will confirm audience exclusions and UTM naming before launch.

## Budget and measurement
Allocate $18,000 to paid social, $4,000 to paid search, and $2,000 to email production and testing, for a total campaign budget of $25,000. Review spend, trial starts, paid conversions, and acquisition cost each Monday. Walter will deliver a closeout report by 10/23/2026 with channel results and recommendations for the winter campaign.
